stanza: Oh, comedy

q.line: With the hate of some other man's beliefs
stanza: She moved with shameless wonder
The perfect creature rarely seen
Since some liar brought the thunder
When the land was godless and free
Her eyes look sharp and steady
Into the empty parts of me
Still, my heart is heavy
With the hate of some other man's beliefs

q.songTitle: We’ve Come Too Far to Turn Around
stanza: We have stared into the eyes of evil
We have slow-danced with the devil
We have sat down at his table
And shared with him in the feast
We have swallowed the liquid of his lies
Tolerated the one we despise
Been led astray by his disguise
Fooled by his beliefs

partner.line: And shared with him in the feast

q.songTitle: I Will Bury You in Time
stanza: I will bury you in time
When the sea begins to slide
Into this hole where I am smiling on your shoulder
You have buried my beliefs
Where all you sisters sleep
That their scent the purity will make
When the youth is over
Frozen in some lost October
I'll drown my beliefs
To have your babies
I'll dress like your niece
And wash your swollen feet
